calculation.description: Compute each asset's one-day return residual after removing its rolling 60-session beta to the cross-asset median return, then apply a moderate absolute DXY-return stress multiplier. DXY is observation-only and is lagged to the prior completed session.

parameters.cross_asset_market: daily median return across 15 tradable instruments

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in 2020-2022 (+0.056158; 743 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.048872; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.030424; 574 dates). Small 15-instrument cross-section; uncertainty interpreted across 1,833 dates.
